From: Samir Gupta <samir@acme-analytics.com>
To: camila.reyes@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-05T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace inquiry — interest in Redwood inference

Hi Camila,

We found Redwood via the cloud marketplace listing and I signed up for a trial yesterday. We run real-time inference for several customer-facing features and are evaluating better latency/cost profiles — I saw your marketplace blurb and would love a short intro and demo of the platform.

A few quick details about us:
- Team: 4 ML engineers + 2 infra
- Volume: ~10M tokens/day across several endpoints
- Priority: lower latency for real-time features, multi-region routing

Are you available for a 30-min intro/demo this week? Happy to share more context in advance.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Gupta
Director of Platform Engineering
Acme Analytics
samir@acme-analytics.com

Hi Samir — great to meet you and welcome onboard! I'm Camila on the inbound SDR team — thanks for signing up and flagging your use case.

We typically do a 30-minute intro + product demo where an AE runs through how customers optimize latency/cost with Redwood and how our Dedicated/Private options look. Marissa (cc'd) will run the demo so she can surface relevant config for your scale.

A few quick options this week (all PST):
- Tue Aug 5: 3:00–3:30pm
- Wed Aug 6: 10:00–10:30am
- Wed Aug 6: 2:00–2:30pm

Or you can pick a slot on my calendar: https://calendly.com/camila-reyes/30min

If you can, share which environment you tried the trial in (GCP us-west1 / AWS us-west-2 / other) and any sample throughput/latency targets — will help us tailor the demo.

Attached: redwood-one-pager.pdf (quick overview).

Best,
Camila Reyes
Inbound SDR | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com
